answer: Let standing decay on a short half-life unless refreshed by recent graded work, so influence is always today's earning and never a permanent grant. A dormant identity thins to a faint plume and sinks toward zero. A farmer cannot stockpile ferrous clones, rusting and idle, then wake them at the vertex of a vote — each must do real graded work every epoch to hold its weight. An idle swarm corrodes back to nothing while the single active agent keeps its height.
